visual_logic.surface_detail: Mottled 'Olive Green' and 'Sandy Tan' skin with visible, flattened osteoderms mapped continuously along its expansive horizontal back profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains heavily on the 'needle-thin' snout, displaying the interlocking teeth perfectly parallel to the frame edge.
visual_logic.facial_expression: Observational and patient; large eyes adjusted for the lateral profile layout view.

environment.water: Shallow, sun-lit lagoon water over 'Creamy White' carbonate mud.
environment.biota: The cluster of 'Ancestral Seagrass' and small crustaceans are pushed entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, unobstructed silhouette line.

visual_logic.pose: The marine crocodilian is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original stationary seabed position is converted into a level, straight cruising path, extending its elongated fanged snout, armored torso, limbs, and long tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
